title: Knowledge check: Extending Django Internals Responsibly

questions.prompt: Which topic is explicitly listed for “Extending Django Internals Responsibly”?
options: A complete substitute for server-side validation
A guarantee that every database write succeeds atomically
A feature that is always enabled without configuration
questions.explanation: The supplied Django curriculum lists “Understanding public versus internal APIs” under lesson 247, “Extending Django Internals Responsibly”. The lesson connects this item to the practical Django workflow for advanced django architecture.

questions.prompt: Which workflow best supports reliable work on “Extending Django Internals Responsibly”?
options: Publish an example before checking framework/version compatibility.
Use a documented small example, verify expected behavior, and test an invalid or boundary case.
Assume the browser is trusted and skip server-side checks.
Copy a production secret into the source file so every environment matches.
questions.answer_key: Use a documented small example, verify expected behavior, and test an invalid or boundary case.
questions.explanation: Small reproducible examples, server-side validation where relevant, and explicit positive/negative checks help distinguish expected behavior from assumptions. Version, environment, and boundary cases should be documented.

questions.prompt: Which practice is most appropriate when applying “Extending Django Internals Responsibly” in a real application?
options: Measure query behavior and verify the proposed optimization with representative data.
Add indexes to every field without checking query plans.
Materialize every database row into memory before filtering.
Assume that reducing query count always makes every request faster.
questions.answer_key: Measure query behavior and verify the proposed optimization with representative data.
questions.explanation: The lesson is part of Advanced Django Architecture. Select the approach that supports correctness, safe handling of failures, and verifiable behavior; see the linked official documentation for version-specific details.

notes: Answer keys and explanations remain in the server-side course repository. The existing CodeLeaf GET handler strips answers until grading; this course does not expose solutions in public lesson content.
